description: Bass oscillator: a sine with a second and a third harmonic mixed in, a wave folder, and a second voice that can be switched in

params.text: Sets the level of the mixed sines before the folder, from silence at the counter-clockwise end to twice at the clockwise end
Sets the voltage at which the wave is reflected back on itself; turned past the peak of the signal it folds nothing, and at the counter-clockwise end the wave comes out inverted and unchanged
Scales the voltage at the jack above it before that voltage is added to the fold knob; at the counter-clockwise end that jack does nothing
Sets the pitch, from three octaves below middle C at the counter-clockwise end to middle C at the clockwise end, and two octaves below middle C by default
Switches the Exciter voice on, which adds the fundamental again together with a sine at half its rate; the Exciter lamp lights while it is on
Sets the level of the second harmonic, one octave above the fundamental, from silence to twice the fundamental
Sets the level of the Exciter voice, which reaches the output only while the Exciter switch is on
Sets the level of the third harmonic, an octave and a fifth above the fundamental rather than the two octaves the panel lettering implies

inputs.text: Added straight to the volume knob, one volt raising the level by half that knob's whole travel, with nothing clamping the total
Added to the fold knob after the trimmer below it, one volt raising the fold point by half that knob's whole travel
Added to the pitch knob at 1V per octave; the total is held between four octaves below and four octaves above middle C
Added straight to the second harmonic knob, one volt raising its level by half that knob's whole travel
Added straight to the third harmonic knob, one volt raising its level by half that knob's whole travel

outputs.text: Carries the oscillator at five volts for each unit of the mixed sines, so with the harmonic and volume knobs turned up it runs well past ±10V unless the fold knob is brought down

notes: no cable is needed to start it: the oscillator runs from the moment the module is placed, two octaves below middle C
the maker gave no name to any knob or jack here, so hovering one of them shows nothing
